text:
Samir A.: quick question on audit coverage/retention for customer-facing audit events — we need a clear design for WORM + KMS + export validation. thinking: 7yr retention, S3 with Object Lock (GOVERNANCE), CMK per-customer, and an export/validation API. thoughts? :thinking:
Lina M.: per-customer CMKs ok but key rotation and cross-region restore are tricky. do we need separate export-encryption keys vs storage keys?
BenT: we should separate envelope encryption for export artifacts from at-rest S3 encryption. keep CMK for S3 object encryption, use a short-lived EEK for exported bundles. also need manifest signing.
Samir A.: agree. also need to ensure schema for "customer_audit_event" is stable so customers can validate after export. propose adding "event_version" and "canonical_id" fields and a canonical signing payload.
security-bot: Note: existing audit pipeline writes events to kafka -> lambda -> s3-archive. Current retention TTL is 3650 days in metadata, but Object Lock isn't enabled yet on archive buckets.
Harper: can we enable Object Lock without bucket re-creation? last time AWS said you must set at creation. that implies migration plan.
Lina M.: correct — S3 Object Lock must be enabled at bucket creation. migration options: 1) create new locked buckets and copy objects (copying can preserve legal-hold but needs special handling), 2) use Glacier Vault Lock for archives. both have tradeoffs for immutability guarantees.
Samir A.: timeline/asks: 1) schema with versioning + example payload (so customers can run validation). 2) migration plan for enabling WORM for historical data. 3) KMS key policy doc for per-customer CMKs & rotation. 4) export validation CLI.
BenT: I'll sketch a minimal schema and a simple CLI validator. putting example here:
```json
{
  "event_version": "1.0",
  "timestamp": "2026-02-18T15:12:31Z",
  "customer_id": "acct_12345",
  "canonical_id": "evt_0000001",
  "actor": {"id": "user_99","role":"admin"},
  "action": "model.deploy",
  "resource": {"type":"deployment","id":"d_77"},
  "outcome": "success",
  "metadata": {"model":"redwood-v1","seq_len":512},
  "signature": "base64sig..."
}
```
Samir A.: signature field is HMAC-SHA256 over canonical payload using an export signing key. need to store signing public keys in a catalogue for customer validation.
Harper: For KMS: per-customer CMKs are okay but we must avoid too many keys in the account. consider multi-tenant CMK with per-customer DEKs (data encryption keys) wrapped by the CMK. rotation: automatic schedule but retain old keys for rewrap for exports.
Lina M.: audit exports for eDiscovery: customers will want both object-level integrity and a separate attestation. we should produce a signed manifest + sha256 per object. example manifest format:
```
{
  "manifest_version":"1",
  "export_id":"exp_20260218_001",
  "customer_id":"acct_12345",
  "objects":[{"key":"audit/2026/02/18/evt_0000001.json.gz","sha256":"...","size":345}],
  "signed_by":"kms-key-arn:alias/export-signing/acct_12345",
  "signature":"base64sig..."
}
```
BenT: CLI for validation would: fetch manifest, verify signature via KMS or a published verification key, then download each object and check sha256. keep it streaming to avoid large downloads.
Samir A.: migration plan bullet points idea:
- create new S3 bucket(s) with Object Lock enabled and Glacier Deep Archive lifecycle for older objects
- copy existing active archives into new buckets using multipart copy with metadata preserved and set legal-hold during copy
- ensure CMKs used in the new buckets follow per-customer DEK wrapping model
- mark old buckets read-only and set retention until deletion allowed by legal/compliance
Lina M.: question: legal-hold vs retention mode (GOVERNANCE vs COMPLIANCE). for true immutability you need COMPLIANCE but that blocks root-level deletes. get legal sign-off.
Harper: add monitoring: number of exports, last-verified export timestamp, failed integrity checks. also add alerting on KMS Deny errors and cross-region replication failures.
Samir A.: action items: @Lina can you draft a KMS key policy and rotation notes? @BenT try a CLI prototype and schema validator. @Harper propose migration runbook + cost estimate for copying ~3TB of archives. I'll draft schema + export manifest spec.
Lina M.: will do, will also call legal for preferred retention mode.
BenT: I'll prototype validator tomorrow, will post a short thread with test vector. :thumbsup:
security-bot: created task SEC-1129: "Audit archive WORM + KMS export validation spec" assigned to security team. link: https://redwood.internal/track/SEC-1129
Harper: one more note — for customer key material: if customers insist on holding their own CMK (BYOK/HSM), we need clear instructions for cross-account grants and a validation flow for decrypting manifests. document that in runbook.
Samir A.: thanks everyone — this is the plan. we'll sync in next eng-security sync. :lock:
